purpose: silver_nyc_flights provides cleaned, typed flight schedule and delay records for 2013 NYC-origin flights, feeding downstream flight delay analytics and on-time performance reporting.
usage: Consumers should join or aggregate on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin) and must explicitly handle nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum, which represent cancelled or unrecorded flight legs rather than zero values.
limitations: Roughly 2.9%-3.3% of rows have null dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time, and 0.9% have null tailnum; these nulls were retained rather than imputed. No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 over 166,158 rows), but the source has no natural surrogate key, so the declared grain assumes a single flight per carrier, flight number, origin, and day.
